lines.text: Jesus says the kingdom is like treasure hidden in a field, which a man buys after selling all he had.
A merchant seeking fine pearls finds one very precious pearl and sells all he had to buy it.
A net cast into the sea catches all kinds of fish, and the men sort the good into containers.
The angels will separate the wicked from the righteous and throw them into the lions' den.
Jesus says every priest discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner with new and old treasures.
